relationships.subject: thermoTRP channels
relationships.evidence_quote: These channels, and especially TRPV1, TRPA1 and TRPM8, have been subjected to profound investigation because of their role as thermosensors and also because of their implication in acute and chronic pain

relationships.subject: sexual hormones
relationships.evidence_quote: the function of these channels may be differently modulated in males and females, in part through sexual hormones

key_findings: Review: thermoTRP channels (TRPV1, TRPA1, TRPM8) may be differentially modulated in males and females, contributing to sex differences in chronic migraine and CIPN.
